candidates.reason: Stages counts by route and day-of-month, then aggregates routes with an explicit BIGINT cast to preserve COUNT(*) output type and the original date filter.
candidates.sql:
WITH staged AS (
  SELECT PULocationID AS pickup,
         DOLocationID AS dropoff,
         EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_day,
         COUNT(*) AS partial_trips
  FROM trips
  WHERE EXTRACT(day FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) <= 7
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
)
SELECT pickup,
       dropoff,
       CAST(SUM(partial_trips) AS BIGINT) AS trips
FROM staged
GROUP BY 1, 2
